medium: split screen: a real-world clip, product photo or screenshot in a panel above, the creator below on black; white italic bold caps captions
avoid: illustration, cartoon, 3D render, coloured backgrounds, text baked into the image
note: Every frame is the creator with a panel above him; only the panel is generatable, so reference stills are cropped to the panel. Comparison cards carry their numbers as baked text - never generated. Caption: white italic bold caps, centred low.

looks.label: Real-world clip in the top panel
looks.when: the default - the thing itself: a product, a place, a process, food, a machine - as filmed footage or a product photo.
looks.prompt: A widescreen photograph or video frame of the subject in the real world - food on a tray, a machine at work, a shop front, a fixture on a tiled wall - natural or overhead light, true colour, slightly soft like a phone clip, filling the frame edge to edge. No words.

looks.label: Screenshot in the top panel
looks.when: a listing, a price, a website, an app screen, a piece of software - shown as a screenshot.
looks.prompt: A widescreen screenshot of a web page or an app: white or dark grey interface, a product image or two, price and title lines as illegible grey text, clean flat layout, filling the frame. No readable words, no real brand names.

looks.label: Two things side by side with numbers
looks.when: two items compared with a number under each - the numbers are baked text, never generated.

looks.label: Creator below the panel
looks.when: the creator on camera - never generated.
